subjects.name: SUPERAGENT

profile.summary: Insurance platform spanning inbound, outbound, training, live-call support, retention and quoting.
profile.audience: Independent and captive US insurance agencies, from individual producers to multi-office teams.
profile.positioning: An integrated insurance workflow across acquisition, producer development and policy servicing.
profile.offer: 14-day trial on the homepage; demonstration-led plan selection.
profile.pricing: Pro $499/month; Scale $999/month; Enterprise $2,499+/month. Starter $299/month requires eligibility approval; usage allowances and overages apply.
profile.cta: Start 14-day free trial / Book a demo
differentiators: Training, quoting and retention in the same suite
AMS, CRM, telephony and calendar integrations
limitations: The inbound product FAQ still states $249/month while the pricing page states $299 for restricted Starter. Resolve the discrepancy before putting a price in an ad.
Published customer outcomes are vendor claims, not paid-ad performance.

sources.title: SUPERAGENT current product and trial
sources.summary: The homepage offers six agents for insurance agencies and a 14-day trial. Product examples span call capture, follow-up and producer coaching.

sources.title: SUPERAGENT plans and eligibility
sources.summary: Monthly plans: restricted Starter $299; Pro $499; Scale $999; Enterprise from $2,499. Pro includes 1,350 inbound/outbound minutes and 1,050 quotes. Starter applicants need approval; overage packs are extra.

sources.title: SUPERAGENT inbound agent
sources.summary: The agent qualifies calls, routes service/claims/billing/sales requests, books appointments and provides a contextual human handoff. The FAQ lists Starter at $249, inconsistent with the pricing page.

sources.title: SUPERAGENT outbound workflows
sources.summary: Lead lists, new form submissions and dormant accounts feed multi-touch campaigns across phone, SMS and email. Qualified replies are handed to producers. This supports a follow-through campaign direction.

sources.title: SUPERAGENT insurance integrations
sources.summary: Listed connections include Applied Epic, EZLynx, HawkSoft, QQCatalyst and AMS360. The page describes call logging, CRM contact creation, appointment booking and follow-up email workflows.

profile.summary: P&C-focused receptionist for call triage, quote intake, scheduling and agency-system updates.
profile.audience: P&C agencies, brokers and insurance distributors; dedicated mid-market and enterprise pages.
profile.positioning: Protect licensed staff time by automating routine incoming calls and agency administration.
profile.offer: Personalized demo of insurance-specific call handling.
profile.pricing: Custom quote; no public plan price on the reviewed homepage.
differentiators: Quote intake and notes written to agency systems
limitations: Google ads were last shown in February 2026; this does not establish current delivery.

sources.title: Sonant insurance receptionist
sources.summary: Sonant sells routine-call automation to insurance agencies, including human transfer, quote intake, scheduling and multilingual support. It emphasizes production time and staff capacity. No public plan price is displayed.

sources.title: Sonant mid-market P&C agencies
